visual.description: Full-width nav with left navigation links, centered logo, and right utility links plus CTA button.
Full-bleed hero image with bold headline text overlapping on left side and a centered search bar floating over the image.
Horizontal scrolling carousel of property cards in 4 equal-width columns with nav arrows top-right.
Collapsed sticky nav showing logo left and search bar center, with right side cleared.
Left panel shows a mortgage calculator form with a CTA, right area shows a horizontal row of property cards at partial visibility.
Single centered call-to-action text link spanning the full container width.
Three equal-width cards on a light grey background each with illustration, heading, body text, and an outlined CTA button.
Second horizontal property card carousel in 4 equal columns with price, bed/bath/sqft details below images.
Centered heading and body paragraph spanning full width explaining Zillow's recommendation algorithm.
Four equal-width footer nav categories (Real Estate, Rentals, Mortgage Rates, Browse Homes) with dropdown chevrons, separated by vertical dividers.
Three rows of centered text links for legal and informational pages, followed by a privacy opt-out link.
Dense centered legal text block with inline hyperlinks, address, and regulatory disclosures.
Centered row containing App Store / Google Play badges, Zillow logo, social media icons, copyright, and equal housing logo all on a single line.
